title: Glowing piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura behind piano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='42' ry='30' fill='#1a2a4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#2a3a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Piano body - deep purple/slate -->
  <rect x='12' y='30' width='76' height='40' rx='4' fill='#4a2a6a'/>
  <!-- Top lid -->
  <rect x='12' y='28' width='76' height='6' rx='3' fill='#6a3a8a'/>
  <!-- Lid highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='29' width='72' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8a5aaa'/>
  
  <!-- Piano body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='12' y='30' width='76' height='3' rx='2' fill='#5a3a7a'/>
  
  <!-- Keyboard area background -->
  <rect x='16' y='52' width='68' height='16' rx='2' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  
  <!-- White keys - glowing -->
  <rect x='17' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#e0f0ff'/>
  <rect x='25' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c8e8ff'/>
  <rect x='33' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#e0f0ff'/>
  <rect x='41' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c8e8ff'/>
  <rect x='49' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#e0f0ff'/>
  <rect x='57' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c8e8ff'/>
  <rect x='65' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#e0f0ff'/>
  <rect x='73' y='53' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c8e8ff'/>
  
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x='22' y='53' width='4' height='9' rx='1' fill='#2a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='53' width='4' height='9' rx='1' fill='#2a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='53' width='4' height='9' rx='1' fill='#2a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='53' width='4' height='9' rx='1' fill='#2a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='53' width='4' height='9' rx='1' fill='#2a1a5a'/>
  
  <!-- Black keys with glow highlights -->
  <rect x='22' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='53' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  
  <!-- Music notes floating above -->
  <g fill='#ffe84a'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='18' rx='5' ry='4'/>
    <rect x='33' y='8' width='2' height='11' rx='1'/>
    <ellipse cx='55' cy='14' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='58' y='5' width='2' height='10' rx='1'/>
    <ellipse cx='75' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='78' y='11' width='2' height='10' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle glow dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='20' r='1' fill='#ffe84a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='16' r='1' fill='#ffe84a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Piano legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='70' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#3a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='74' y='70' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#3a1a5a'/>
  <rect x='20' y='70' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3a7a'/>
  <rect x='74' y='70' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a3a7a'/>
  
  <!-- Soft glow under piano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a3a6a' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
